# Phil Gordon & Priscilla Grant

- [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — Friend of — [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) — college friends and companions · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Park P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> After registering for classes at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and feeling overwhelmed by the unfamiliar environment, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) take a stroll through Old St. John's Cemetery. There they meet [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), a friendly and talkative fellow student from [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia). The three girls strike up an instant friendship while sitting on a gravestone, sharing their mutual feelings of homesickness and experiences on their first day.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) chats exuberantly with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) about her suitors back home, her reluctance to grow up, and her impressions of [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). After discovering an old war grave in the cemetery that deeply moves [Anne](../character/anne.md), the trio parts ways. [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) then discuss Phil's lively character, agreeing that despite her frivolity, they genuinely like her.
>
> — v3 · Chapter IV April’s Lady

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), finding themselves drawn into social circles through their friendship with [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) earns distinction among the Freshmen after leading them to victory in the annual Arts Rush. Anne's homesickness is relieved when she receives a collection of letters from her friends and family back home in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

> [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), and [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) go for an afternoon walk with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) through the park and along the harbor shore. After watching the sunset from a pavilion, they walk back via [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue) where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) points out a charming, quaint house called Patty's Place. [Anne](../character/anne.md) feels an instant connection to the house and has a strong presentiment that she will become better acquainted with it.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

> After finishing term examinations at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday where she is warmly greeted by [Diana](../character/diana.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and the twins. That night, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps a troubled [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) through a dilemma about wanting to say a bad word so that he feels ready to say his prayers. During the break, [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives letters from her friends, shares news with her family, and visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) with [Diana](../character/diana.md) to air out the house and listen to the echoes once more.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) visit Patty's Place and successfully arrange to rent the house from Miss [Patty](../character/patty.md) Spofford and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Afterward, [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) to ask if she can live with them at Patty's Place, and they agree subject to consulting [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter X Patty’s Place

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends settle into Patty's Place and decorate their new home. [Anne](../character/anne.md) reluctantly adopts a stray, disreputable cat named [Rusty](../character/rusty.md), who miraculously survives a chloroforming attempt and earns a permanent spot in the house. [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) arrives with her own cats, adding to the household's lively atmosphere.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> At Patty's Place, the girls prepare for exams and learn that they can rent the house for another year while the owners travel abroad. Later, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) go for a walk in the park, where [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) reveals she has accepted [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) Blake's marriage proposal. As they discuss Phil's future and Anne's feelings for [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) ponders her ideal romance alongside Roy's lack of humor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVII Mutual Confidences

> The girls return to Patty's Place and chatter with [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) about their vacations, Phil's engagement, and Aunt Jamesina's past suitors. Later in the term, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) cure a rainy-day bout of melancholy by reading over old, melodramatic stories written by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club), inspiring [Anne](../character/anne.md) to rewrite one of her old sketches.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXV The Last Redmond Year Opens

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) receives news that her short sketch has been accepted by a publication, sparking literary excitement among the girls at Patty's Place. While on a walking party, [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md) tells [Anne](../character/anne.md) that his mother and sisters plan to call on her. The Gardners arrive a day earlier than expected on Friday, leading to an awkward but ultimately successful first visit despite cat chaos and a ruined chocolate cake.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and her friends reflect on what they have learned at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their examinations finish up. On [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation) day, [Anne](../character/anne.md) chooses Gilbert's lilies over Roy's violets to carry, but later learns of a rumor about Gilbert's engagement to [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), leading her to secretly break the chain [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) gave her. After attending the graduation dance, the girls unwind back at Patty's Place while [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) mentions a visitor.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s
